title: 5G Radiation
summary: Misinformation claims 5G wireless technology emits dangerous radiation causing cancer, COVID-19, and other health problems.
introduction: Despite scientific consensus that 5G technology is safe when operated within established guidelines, widespread misinformation has fueled fears about its health effects. These myths falsely claim that 5G radiation causes cancer, spreads viruses like COVID-19, weakens immune systems, and poses environmental dangers. In reality, 5G uses non-ionizing radiofrequency radiation at levels well below international safety limits set by organizations like ICNIRP, WHO, and national regulatory bodies across multiple countries.
